learning_outcomes.text: Knows the requirements for power transmission organs in vehicles.
Expresses the structure and operation of the clutch system in written and oral form and fixes its malfunctions.
Explains/expresses concepts related to the gearbox of mechanical front-wheel drive and rear-wheel drive vehicles in written and oral form.
Calculates gear ratio, torque, speed ratio, and power related to the gearbox.
Explains/expresses concepts related to the gearbox of vehicles with automatic transmission in written and oral form.
Explains/expresses concepts related to shaft, axle, and differential in written and oral form.

syllabus_topics: Determination of gear ratios, practical examples of automotive and industrial gearboxes
Gearbox design, Universal joints, Sliding joints, Shaft, and Axles
assessment_rules: Midterm and final exam dates are not specified in the 14-week course schedule. Midterm and final exam dates are held on the dates specified in the academic calendar by the decision of the University Senate.
